pages.text: {{hero}} likes to gaze up at the night sky and dream of space. One day, a white rocket lands at the gate with a note: "Hop in, {{hero}}!" So {{hero}} hops in and sits down.
{{hero}} hits the green switch, and the rocket blasts up, up, up into space. The land and sea get small and then smaller. {{hero}} wants to land on a pale gray rock and bring home a stone.
But the gray rock is all dust. {{hero}} digs and digs, but there is not a stone in sight. {{hero}} sits down with a sigh. Maybe there are no stones at all.
Then {{hero}} spots a gleam in the dust. It is a stone that shines like a light! {{hero}} picks it up, packs it in the ship, and blasts back home just in time for bed.
That night, {{hero}} sets the stone by the bed and drifts to sleep. The stone glows a soft white. But late at night, the stone hums a tune. What is the stone trying to say?
